title: 多义词详解 · 截图收藏

entries.notes: on credit 赊购；give sb credit for 认可某人的贡献；to one's credit 值得赞扬的是；credit A to B 将A归功于B。credit card 信用卡，不等于 debit card 借记卡。

senses.definitionEn: Trust that allows someone to obtain goods or money and pay later.

example.en: We bought the furniture on credit.
example.zh: 我们赊购了这些家具。

senses.definitionEn: Praise or recognition for an achievement.

example.en: She deserves credit for solving the problem.
example.zh: 解决这个问题的功劳应归于她。

senses.definitionEn: A unit awarded for completing an academic course.

example.en: This course is worth three credits.
example.zh: 这门课程计三个学分。

senses.meaningZh: 账户贷记金额；可用余额
senses.definitionEn: An amount added to an account or available to spend.

example.en: There is a credit of twenty dollars on your account.
example.zh: 你的账户上有二十美元的贷记余额。

senses.meaningZh: 片头或片尾演职员名单
senses.definitionEn: A list naming the people who made a film or programme.

example.en: Her name appears in the closing credits.
example.zh: 她的名字出现在片尾演职员表中。

senses.definitionEn: To recognize someone as responsible for something or possessing a quality.

example.en: He is credited with inventing the device.
example.zh: 这项装置的发明被归功于他。

senses.definitionEn: To add an amount of money to an account.

example.en: The bank credited the refund to my account.
example.zh: 银行把退款记入了我的账户。

senses.definitionEn: To believe that something surprising is true.

example.en: I could hardly credit what I was hearing.
example.zh: 我几乎无法相信自己听到的话。

entries.notes: 可贬可褒，需看语境。aggressive behaviour 攻击性行为；aggressive marketing 强势营销；aggressive growth 快速扩张。

senses.definitionEn: Ready to attack or argue with others.

example.en: The dog became aggressive when approached.
example.zh: 有人靠近时，那只狗变得有攻击性。

senses.definitionEn: Pursuing a goal with great energy and determination.

example.en: The company adopted an aggressive sales strategy.
example.zh: 公司采取了积极进取的销售策略。

senses.meaningZh: 迅速发展的；侵袭性强的
senses.definitionEn: Developing or spreading quickly and harmfully.

example.en: The disease can follow an aggressive course.
example.zh: 这种疾病可能迅速恶化。

entries.notes: 可数名词指“熟人”；不可数用法指“了解”。acquaintance with；make sb's acquaintance 结识；an acquaintance of mine 我的一个熟人。

senses.definitionEn: Someone you know, but not a close friend.

example.en: He is an acquaintance from university.
example.zh: 他是我在大学认识的一位熟人。

senses.definitionEn: The state or experience of knowing someone.

example.en: Our acquaintance began at a conference.
example.zh: 我们是在一次会议上认识的。

senses.definitionEn: Knowledge of a subject gained through experience or study.

example.en: She has some acquaintance with Chinese history.
example.zh: 她对中国历史略有了解。

entries.notes: a dash of 少量；dash off 匆匆写下或迅速离开；dash one's hopes 使希望破灭。破折号 dash 与连字符 hyphen 不同。

senses.definitionEn: To move suddenly and quickly; a quick run.

example.en: We made a dash for the last bus.
example.zh: 我们冲向了末班公交车。

senses.definitionEn: To throw or strike something violently against a surface.

example.en: Waves dashed against the rocks.
example.zh: 海浪猛烈撞击着岩石。

senses.definitionEn: To destroy someone's hopes or expectations.

example.en: The cancellation dashed our hopes of travelling.
example.zh: 行程取消使我们出游的希望破灭了。

senses.definitionEn: A small amount added to something.

example.en: Add a dash of milk to the tea.
example.zh: 往茶里加少许牛奶。

senses.definitionEn: A punctuation mark used to separate or interrupt parts of a sentence.

example.en: Use a dash to introduce the explanation.
example.zh: 用破折号引出解释。

senses.definitionEn: Energy, confidence, or stylish behaviour.

example.en: He played the role with great dash.
example.zh: 他把这个角色演得神采飞扬。

entries.notes: 较正式，常为不可数名词。have recourse to 求助于；without recourse to 不借助；have no recourse but to do 除了做……别无办法。不要与 resource（资源）混淆。

senses.definitionEn: The act of turning to someone or something for help.

example.en: They settled the dispute without recourse to the courts.
example.zh: 他们没有诉诸法院就解决了争端。

senses.meaningZh: 可依靠的办法；救济途径
senses.definitionEn: A source of help or a way of obtaining a remedy.

example.en: Our only recourse was to appeal.
example.zh: 我们唯一的补救途径就是上诉。

entries.notes: 名词表示成段的语言、讨论或话语体系，不是 discount。动词较正式：discourse on/upon 谈论。直接交流、学术论述和社会话语均可使用。

senses.definitionEn: Serious spoken or written discussion of a subject.

example.en: The issue has shaped public discourse.
example.zh: 这个问题影响了公共讨论。

senses.definitionEn: Connected language considered beyond individual sentences.

example.en: We analysed the structure of classroom discourse.
example.zh: 我们分析了课堂话语的结构。

senses.definitionEn: To speak or write at length about a subject.

example.en: She discoursed on the history of the city.
example.zh: 她详细谈论了这座城市的历史。

entries.notes: fly—flew—flown；fly to 飞往；fly a kite 放风筝；fly into a rage 勃然大怒；time flies 时间飞逝。苍蝇复数 flies。

senses.definitionEn: To move through the air, travel by plane, or control an aircraft.

example.en: We flew to Shanghai yesterday.
example.zh: 我们昨天乘飞机去了上海。

senses.meaningZh: 使飞起；悬挂或飘扬旗帜
senses.definitionEn: To cause something to move or remain in the air.

example.en: Children were flying kites in the park.
example.zh: 孩子们在公园里放风筝。

senses.definitionEn: To move, spread, or pass very quickly.

example.en: Time flies when you are having fun.
example.zh: 玩得开心时，时间过得飞快。

senses.definitionEn: To be accepted or considered workable.

example.en: That excuse will not fly with the teacher.
example.zh: 老师不会接受那个借口。

senses.definitionEn: A small flying insect.

example.en: A fly landed on the window.
example.zh: 一只苍蝇落在窗户上。

senses.definitionEn: To flee from danger or an unpleasant situation.

example.en: They were forced to fly the country.
example.zh: 他们被迫逃离那个国家。

senses.meaningZh: 裤子前面的开口或门襟
senses.definitionEn: The opening at the front of a pair of trousers.

example.en: Your fly is open.
example.zh: 你的裤子门襟开了。

entries.notes: it 的反身形式。by itself 独自；自动地；in itself 本身；of itself 自发地。itself 强调单数事物，复数用 themselves。

senses.definitionEn: The reflexive form of it, referring back to the subject.

example.en: The cat washed itself.
example.zh: 猫给自己洗了脸。

senses.definitionEn: Used to emphasize a thing already mentioned.

example.en: The building itself is beautiful.
example.zh: 这座建筑本身就很漂亮。

senses.definitionEn: Used in phrases describing independence or intrinsic qualities.

example.en: The door closed by itself.
example.zh: 门自己关上了。

entries.notes: drop—dropped—dropped；drop in 顺便拜访；drop out (of) 退出或辍学；drop off 送下车、减少或睡着；drop by 顺便来访。

senses.definitionEn: To fall or let something fall.

example.en: I dropped my phone on the floor.
example.zh: 我把手机掉在地板上了。

senses.definitionEn: To become lower in amount or level; a decrease.

example.en: There was a sharp drop in prices.
example.zh: 价格大幅下降。

senses.definitionEn: To stop doing, including, or discussing something.

example.en: They dropped the plan because of the cost.
example.zh: 他们因费用问题放弃了计划。

senses.definitionEn: To take someone somewhere and leave them there.

example.en: Could you drop me at the station?
example.zh: 你能把我送到车站吗？

senses.definitionEn: A small rounded amount of liquid.

example.en: A drop of rain fell on my hand.
example.zh: 一滴雨落在我手上。

senses.definitionEn: A vertical distance down from a surface.

example.en: There is a steep drop beyond the wall.
example.zh: 墙外有一处很陡的落差。

entries.notes: glow 指持续柔和的光，flash 指闪光，shine 范围更广。glow with pride 因自豪而容光焕发；a warm glow 温暖的光或满足感。

senses.definitionEn: To produce a steady soft light; such light.

example.en: The embers glowed in the dark.
example.zh: 余烬在黑暗中发着微光。

senses.definitionEn: To look warm and pink, often from health or emotion.

example.en: Her cheeks glowed after the run.
example.zh: 跑步后她双颊红润。

senses.definitionEn: To show or feel strong pleasure or satisfaction.

example.en: He glowed with pride at the news.
example.zh: 听到消息，他满脸自豪。

entries.notes: catch—caught—caught；catch up with 赶上；catch on 流行或理解；catch one's eye 引起注意；catch a cold 感冒；catch fire 着火。

senses.definitionEn: To stop and hold something moving, or capture someone or something.

example.en: She caught the ball with one hand.
example.zh: 她用一只手接住了球。

senses.definitionEn: To reach something in time.

example.en: Hurry or we will not catch the train.
example.zh: 快点，不然我们赶不上火车。

senses.definitionEn: To hear, understand, or notice something.

example.en: I did not catch your name.
example.zh: 我没听清你的名字。

senses.definitionEn: To discover someone doing something, often wrong.

example.en: He was caught cheating in the exam.
example.zh: 他考试作弊被发现了。

senses.definitionEn: To become infected with an illness.

example.en: She caught a cold last week.
example.zh: 她上周感冒了。

senses.definitionEn: To become trapped or attached accidentally.

example.en: My sleeve caught on a nail.
example.zh: 我的袖子被钉子钩住了。

senses.definitionEn: An act of catching or the things caught.

example.en: The fishermen brought in a good catch.
example.zh: 渔民带回了不少渔获。

senses.definitionEn: A hidden disadvantage or condition that makes an offer less attractive.

example.en: The offer sounds good, but what is the catch?
example.zh: 这个提议听起来不错，但有什么隐藏条件？

senses.definitionEn: A small device used to fasten a door, window, or container.

example.en: The catch on the window is broken.
example.zh: 窗户上的搭扣坏了。

entries.notes: just now 刚才或此刻，按时态判断；just about 几乎；not just 不仅；just in case 以防万一。副词常放在所限定成分前。

senses.definitionEn: A very short time before now or another time.

example.en: I have just finished my homework.
example.zh: 我刚做完作业。

senses.definitionEn: Only or simply.

example.en: I just want some water.
example.zh: 我只想喝点水。

senses.definitionEn: Exactly or precisely.

example.en: That is just what I needed.
example.zh: 那正是我需要的。

senses.definitionEn: By a very small margin.

example.en: We just managed to catch the bus.
example.zh: 我们勉强赶上了公交车。

senses.definitionEn: Used to emphasize a statement or request.

example.en: The view is just amazing.
example.zh: 景色简直太棒了。

senses.definitionEn: Fair, morally right, or deserved.

example.en: They demanded a just decision.
example.zh: 他们要求一个公正的决定。

entries.notes: throw—threw—thrown；throw away 扔掉；throw out 丢弃、逐出或提出；throw up 呕吐；throw oneself into 全身投入。

senses.definitionEn: To send something through the air with the hand; an act of doing so.

example.en: He threw the keys to me.
example.zh: 他把钥匙扔给了我。

senses.meaningZh: 猛地移动或使处于某位置
senses.definitionEn: To move something suddenly or forcefully.

example.en: She threw her arms around him.
example.zh: 她一下子张开双臂抱住了他。

senses.definitionEn: To cause someone or something to enter a difficult state.

example.en: The news threw the team into confusion.
example.zh: 这个消息让团队陷入混乱。

senses.definitionEn: To confuse or upset someone unexpectedly.

example.en: The unexpected question threw me.
example.zh: 那个意外的问题让我乱了阵脚。

senses.definitionEn: To organize a party.

example.en: They threw a party for her birthday.
example.zh: 他们为她举办了生日聚会。

senses.definitionEn: A loose decorative covering for furniture.

example.en: She put a soft throw over the sofa.
example.zh: 她在沙发上铺了一条柔软的盖毯。

entries.notes: point out 指出；point to 指向或表明；at this point 此时；on the point of doing 即将；there is no point in doing 做……没有意义。

senses.definitionEn: An idea, important detail, or purpose.

example.en: What is the main point of the article?
example.zh: 这篇文章的主要观点是什么？

senses.definitionEn: A particular place, moment, or stage.

example.en: We have reached a turning point.
example.zh: 我们已经到了一个转折点。

senses.definitionEn: The sharp end of an object.

example.en: The point of the needle is bent.
example.zh: 针尖弯了。

senses.definitionEn: A unit used in scoring or measurement.

example.en: Our team won by two points.
example.zh: 我们队以两分优势获胜。

senses.definitionEn: A decimal mark or an exact position with no size.

example.en: The answer is three point five.
example.zh: 答案是三点五。

senses.definitionEn: To direct a finger or object toward something.

example.en: She pointed to the exit.
example.zh: 她指了指出口。

senses.definitionEn: To give something a sharp end, or face in a direction.

example.en: The arrow points north.
example.zh: 箭头指向北方。

entries.notes: last year 去年，通常不加 the；the last year 可指过去一年或最后一年；at last 终于；last but not least 最后但同样重要。last 作“持续”不及物。

senses.definitionEn: Coming after all others, or the only one remaining.

example.en: This is the last ticket.
example.zh: 这是最后一张票。

senses.definitionEn: Most recent before the present one.

example.en: I saw her last Friday.
example.zh: 我上周五见过她。

senses.definitionEn: After everyone else, or on the most recent occasion.

example.en: When did you last see him?
example.zh: 你上次见他是什么时候？

senses.definitionEn: To continue for a period of time.

example.en: The meeting lasted two hours.
example.zh: 会议持续了两个小时。

senses.definitionEn: To remain usable or sufficient.

example.en: This food should last us three days.
example.zh: 这些食物应该够我们吃三天。

senses.definitionEn: The final person, thing, or part.

example.en: She was the last to leave.
example.zh: 她最后一个离开。

entries.notes: on page 10 在第10页；turn the page 翻页或开启新篇章；a web page 网页；page through 翻阅。page number 页码。

senses.definitionEn: One side of a sheet in a book, or a screen-based document.

example.en: Read the passage on page ten.
example.zh: 阅读第十页上的文章。

senses.definitionEn: A section of a newspaper or magazine.

example.en: The story appeared on the sports pages.
example.zh: 这则报道刊登在体育版。

senses.definitionEn: To call someone by an announcement or electronic message.

example.en: The airport paged the missing passenger.
example.zh: 机场广播呼叫了那位未到的乘客。

senses.definitionEn: A young attendant serving a person or institution.

example.en: A page carried the queen's train.
example.zh: 一名侍童托着王后的长裙后摆。

entries.notes: pass—passed—passed，与 past（过去的、经过）区分；pass away 去世；pass out 昏倒；pass on 转交；pass by 经过。

senses.definitionEn: To move past or beyond someone or something.

example.en: We passed the library on the way.
example.zh: 我们在路上经过了图书馆。

senses.definitionEn: To give something to another person.

example.en: Please pass me the salt.
example.zh: 请把盐递给我。

senses.definitionEn: To succeed in a test, or formally approve something.

example.en: She passed her driving test.
example.zh: 她通过了驾驶考试。

senses.definitionEn: For time to go by, or to spend time.

example.en: We played cards to pass the time.
example.zh: 我们打牌来消磨时间。

senses.definitionEn: To decline an opportunity or take no turn.

example.en: I will pass on dessert today.
example.zh: 我今天就不吃甜点了。

senses.definitionEn: To die, often used with away.

example.en: Her grandfather passed away peacefully.
example.zh: 她的祖父安详地去世了。

senses.definitionEn: A document giving permission to enter or travel.

example.en: You need a visitor's pass to enter.
example.zh: 你需要访客通行证才能进入。

senses.definitionEn: A route through or over mountains.

example.en: The mountain pass is closed in winter.
example.zh: 这个山口冬季封闭。

senses.definitionEn: An act of sending a ball to another player.

example.en: Her accurate pass created a scoring chance.
example.zh: 她精准的传球创造了一次得分机会。

entries.notes: over 不总表示垂直正上方；above 更侧重位置较高。over and over 反复；all over 到处、结束；think over 仔细考虑；get over 克服、康复。

senses.definitionEn: Above something or moving across it.

example.en: The bird flew over the wall.
example.zh: 鸟飞过了墙。

senses.definitionEn: More than a stated number or amount.

example.en: There were over a hundred people.
example.zh: 有一百多人。

senses.definitionEn: During a period of time.

example.en: We discussed it over lunch.
example.zh: 我们午饭时讨论了这件事。

senses.definitionEn: Concerning something, or expressing a cause or control.

example.en: They argued over money.
example.zh: 他们为钱争吵。

senses.definitionEn: Into a different position or onto the other side.

example.en: Turn the page over.
example.zh: 把这一页翻过来。

senses.definitionEn: Again or from the beginning.

example.en: Please start over.
example.zh: 请重新开始。

senses.definitionEn: Finished or no longer happening.

example.en: The exam is over.
example.zh: 考试结束了。

entries.notes: break—broke—broken；break down 故障、崩溃或分解；break up 分手、解散；break into 闯入；break out 爆发；break through 突破。

senses.definitionEn: To separate into pieces or damage something by force.

example.en: Be careful not to break the glass.
example.zh: 小心别打碎玻璃杯。

senses.definitionEn: To fail to obey a rule, promise, or agreement.

example.en: He broke his promise.
example.zh: 他违背了诺言。

senses.meaningZh: 打断；中止；改变连续状态
senses.definitionEn: To interrupt an activity or state.

example.en: Her laugh broke the silence.
example.zh: 她的笑声打破了沉默。

senses.definitionEn: For news to become known, or to make it known.

example.en: The story broke this morning.
example.zh: 这件事今天早上传开了。

senses.definitionEn: To do better than a record or solve a code.

example.en: She broke the school record.
example.zh: 她打破了校纪录。

senses.definitionEn: A short pause in work or another activity.

example.en: Let's take a ten-minute break.
example.zh: 我们休息十分钟吧。

senses.definitionEn: A gap or fracture, or a fortunate opportunity.

example.en: Getting that role was her big break.
example.zh: 获得那个角色是她事业的重大转机。

entries.notes: taste 作“尝起来”是系动词，接形容词：taste good；have a taste for 爱好；to one's taste 合口味；a taste of 初次体验。

senses.definitionEn: The flavour of something or the sense that detects it.

example.en: The soup has a salty taste.
example.zh: 这汤有咸味。

senses.definitionEn: To test food with the mouth, or have a particular flavour.

example.en: The cake tastes delicious.
example.zh: 蛋糕尝起来很好吃。

senses.definitionEn: A small sample or brief experience.

example.en: The trip gave me a taste of independence.
example.zh: 这次旅行让我初尝独立的滋味。

senses.definitionEn: A person's preferences or judgment about quality and style.

example.en: She has excellent taste in music.
example.zh: 她的音乐品味很好。

senses.definitionEn: To experience something, often for the first time.

example.en: The young team tasted victory at last.
example.zh: 这支年轻队伍终于尝到了胜利的滋味。

entries.notes: cross the road 是动词；go across the road 中 across 是介词。cross out 划掉；come across 偶遇；keep one's fingers crossed 祈求好运。

senses.definitionEn: To move from one side of something to the other.

example.en: Look both ways before you cross the road.
example.zh: 过马路前要左右看看。

senses.definitionEn: To place things across each other.

example.en: He sat with his legs crossed.
example.zh: 他交叉双腿坐着。

senses.definitionEn: To oppose or disobey someone.

example.en: You should not cross her when she is angry.
example.zh: 她生气时，你最好别跟她作对。

senses.definitionEn: To breed plants or animals of different types together.

example.en: They crossed two varieties of rose.
example.zh: 他们将两个品种的玫瑰进行了杂交。

senses.meaningZh: 十字形；十字架；杂交品种
senses.definitionEn: A shape made by intersecting lines, or a mixed breed.

example.en: Put a cross next to the wrong answer.
example.zh: 在错误答案旁画一个叉。

senses.definitionEn: Annoyed or angry.

example.en: She was cross with me for being late.
example.zh: 她因为我迟到而生我的气。

entries.notes: a shuttle bus 往返接驳车；space shuttle 航天飞机；shuttle between A and B 在两地间往返。

senses.meaningZh: 往返交通工具；接驳班车
senses.definitionEn: A vehicle that repeatedly travels between two places.

example.en: A free shuttle runs to the airport.
example.zh: 有免费接驳车往返机场。

senses.definitionEn: To move or transport people regularly between places.

example.en: Buses shuttle visitors between the two buildings.
example.zh: 公交车往返两栋楼运送访客。

senses.meaningZh: 梭子；羽毛球（较少见，通常 shuttlecock）
senses.definitionEn: A weaving tool carrying thread, or a shuttlecock.

example.en: The shuttle carries thread across the loom.
example.zh: 梭子把线送过织布机。

senses.definitionEn: A spacecraft designed for repeated journeys between Earth and space.

example.en: The space shuttle returned safely.
example.zh: 航天飞机安全返回了。

entries.notes: 躺／位于：lie—lay—lain，lying；说谎：lie—lied—lied；另一个动词 lay（放置）—laid—laid，需要宾语。lie in 在于；lie down 躺下。

senses.definitionEn: To be or rest in a horizontal position.

example.en: He lay on the sofa all afternoon.
example.zh: 他整个下午都躺在沙发上。

senses.meaningZh: 位于；处在某位置或状态
senses.definitionEn: To be situated somewhere or remain in a state.

example.en: The village lies beside a river.
example.zh: 村庄位于一条河边。

senses.definitionEn: To have its basis or cause in something.

example.en: The problem lies in the lack of practice.
example.zh: 问题在于缺少练习。

senses.definitionEn: To deliberately say something untrue.

example.en: She lied about her age.
example.zh: 她谎报了自己的年龄。

senses.definitionEn: A statement intended to deceive.

example.en: He told a lie to avoid trouble.
example.zh: 他为避免麻烦撒了谎。

senses.definitionEn: The position of something, especially a golf ball or the land.

example.en: The ball had a difficult lie in the rough.
example.zh: 球落在长草区一个很难打的位置。

entries.notes: at sea level 在海平面高度；a high level of 高水平的；level with 与……齐平、对……坦诚；level off 趋于稳定。

senses.definitionEn: A degree of amount, quality, or achievement.

example.en: Her English has reached an advanced level.
example.zh: 她的英语已达到较高水平。

senses.definitionEn: A position measured vertically, or a floor of a building.

example.en: Check the water level in the tank.
example.zh: 检查水箱里的水位。

senses.definitionEn: Flat, horizontal, or at the same height.

example.en: Make sure the table is level.
example.zh: 确保桌面保持水平。

senses.definitionEn: Equal in amount, score, or position.

example.en: The scores were level at half-time.
example.zh: 半场时比分持平。

senses.definitionEn: To make a surface flat or destroy a structure completely.

example.en: The old building was levelled.
example.zh: 那栋旧建筑被夷平了。

senses.definitionEn: To aim something, including criticism, at a target.

example.en: Criticism was levelled at the policy.
example.zh: 批评指向了这项政策。

senses.definitionEn: A tool used to check whether a surface is horizontal.

example.en: Use a level to hang the shelf straight.
example.zh: 用水平仪把架子装平。

entries.notes: a lot of 接可数复数或不可数名词；a lot 修饰动词或比较级；lots of 较口语。the lot 全部；draw lots 抽签。

senses.definitionEn: A large amount or to a great degree.

example.en: I have learned a lot this term.
example.zh: 这学期我学到了很多。

senses.meaningZh: 一批；一组；全部某类东西
senses.definitionEn: A group or quantity considered together.

example.en: This lot of books belongs upstairs.
example.zh: 这批书应该放在楼上。

senses.definitionEn: An area of land used for a particular purpose.

example.en: There is a parking lot behind the bank.
example.zh: 银行后面有一个停车场。

senses.definitionEn: Someone's situation or share in life.

example.en: She tried to improve her lot.
example.zh: 她努力改善自己的处境。

senses.definitionEn: An object used to make a random choice.

example.en: We drew lots to choose the first player.
example.zh: 我们抽签决定谁先开始。

entries.notes: a ticket to/for 票；a ticket to success 成功的途径；a parking ticket 违停罚单；a support ticket 客服工单。

senses.definitionEn: A document or electronic record giving a right to enter or travel.

example.en: I booked a train ticket online.
example.zh: 我在网上订了一张火车票。

senses.definitionEn: An official notice requiring payment for an offence.

example.en: He got a ticket for speeding.
example.zh: 他因超速收到了一张罚单。

senses.definitionEn: A label or numbered record used to identify or track something.

example.en: Please open a support ticket.
example.zh: 请提交一张客服工单。

senses.definitionEn: A means of obtaining something desirable.

example.en: Education can be a ticket to a better future.
example.zh: 教育可以成为通往更好未来的途径。

senses.meaningZh: 候选人名单；政党竞选纲领
senses.definitionEn: A party's candidates or the platform they stand on.

example.en: She ran on the same ticket as the governor.
example.zh: 她与州长候选人搭档竞选。

senses.definitionEn: To issue a ticket or attach a ticket to something.

example.en: Cars parked here will be ticketed.
example.zh: 停在这里的车辆会被开罚单。

entries.notes: blow—blew—blown；blow up 爆炸、充气或勃然大怒；blow out 吹灭；blow over 风波平息；blow one's nose 擤鼻涕。

senses.definitionEn: To move air or be moved by air.

example.en: The wind blew the door shut.
example.zh: 风把门吹关了。

senses.definitionEn: To force air out of the mouth or through an instrument.

example.en: She blew out the candles.
example.zh: 她吹灭了蜡烛。

senses.definitionEn: To explode or stop working because of excess current.

example.en: A fuse blew during the storm.
example.zh: 暴风雨期间一个保险丝熔断了。

senses.definitionEn: To waste money or ruin an opportunity.

example.en: He blew all his savings on a car.
example.zh: 他把全部积蓄都花在一辆车上了。

senses.definitionEn: A hit or a sudden harmful event.

example.en: The news was a serious blow to the team.
example.zh: 这个消息给团队造成了沉重打击。

senses.definitionEn: An act of blowing air or clearing the nose.

example.en: Give your nose a good blow.
example.zh: 好好擤一下鼻子。

entries.notes: 常规过去式 dived；美式也用 dove，过去分词通常 dived。dive into 投入、深入研究；take a dive 暴跌，也可在体育中指假摔或故意输。

senses.definitionEn: To jump into water or swim below its surface; such an activity.

example.en: She dived into the pool.
example.zh: 她跳进了游泳池。

senses.definitionEn: To move suddenly downward or toward something.

example.en: The bird dived for a fish.
example.zh: 鸟俯冲下去捕鱼。

senses.definitionEn: To fall suddenly in value or amount.

example.en: Share prices took a dive.
example.zh: 股价突然暴跌。

senses.definitionEn: To begin an activity eagerly or examine a subject deeply.

example.en: Let's dive into the details.
example.zh: 让我们深入看看细节。

senses.definitionEn: A cheap, unpleasant bar or similar place.

example.en: They met in a small dive near the station.
example.zh: 他们在车站附近一家简陋的小酒吧见了面。

entries.notes: 材料通常不可数；某些原材料、用品用 materials。material to 与……有重大关系。material 作形容词是“物质的”或“重要的”。

senses.definitionEn: A substance used for making something.

example.en: The bridge is made of recycled material.
example.zh: 这座桥由再生材料制成。

senses.definitionEn: Cloth used for clothes or other items.

example.en: This material is soft and light.
example.zh: 这种布料柔软轻薄。

senses.definitionEn: Information or content used for study or creative work.

example.en: The teacher uploaded the reading materials.
example.zh: 老师上传了阅读资料。

senses.definitionEn: A person considered suitable for a particular role.

example.en: She is clearly leadership material.
example.zh: 她显然是当领导的料。

senses.definitionEn: Relating to physical things or possessions.

example.en: They value friendship more than material wealth.
example.zh: 他们看重友谊，胜过物质财富。

senses.definitionEn: Significant enough to affect a decision or situation.

example.en: The change made no material difference.
example.zh: 这个变化没有造成实质性差别。

entries.notes: reserve a room 预订房间；in reserve 留作备用；a nature reserve 自然保护区；without reserve 毫无保留。reserved 还可指拘谨的。

senses.definitionEn: To arrange to keep something for future use.

example.en: I reserved a seat by the window.
example.zh: 我预订了一个靠窗座位。

senses.definitionEn: To keep something for a particular person or purpose.

example.en: These spaces are reserved for disabled drivers.
example.zh: 这些车位专供残疾驾驶员使用。

senses.definitionEn: A supply or group kept for future need.

example.en: The country has large gas reserves.
example.zh: 这个国家天然气储量很大。

senses.definitionEn: An area where wildlife or natural features are protected.

example.en: We visited a nature reserve.
example.zh: 我们参观了一处自然保护区。

senses.definitionEn: A tendency not to show feelings openly.

example.en: Her reserve was mistaken for unfriendliness.
example.zh: 她的矜持被误认为不友好。

senses.definitionEn: A player or force available when needed.

example.en: He started the season as a reserve.
example.zh: 赛季开始时他是一名替补。

entries.notes: 纸张不可数：a piece/sheet of paper；论文、报纸、试卷可数：a paper。papers 还可指证件。on paper 在纸上或理论上。

senses.definitionEn: Thin sheets used for writing, printing, or wrapping.

example.en: Write your name on a piece of paper.
example.zh: 在一张纸上写下你的名字。

senses.definitionEn: A newspaper.

example.en: I read the paper every morning.
example.zh: 我每天早上读报。

senses.definitionEn: A piece of academic writing or research.

example.en: She published a paper on language learning.
example.zh: 她发表了一篇关于语言学习的论文。

senses.definitionEn: An examination or the written questions or answers in it.

example.en: The maths paper was difficult.
example.zh: 数学试卷很难。

senses.definitionEn: Official documents identifying someone or recording something.

example.en: The officer checked our papers.
example.zh: 那名官员检查了我们的证件。

senses.definitionEn: To cover a wall or surface with paper.

example.en: They papered the bedroom walls.
example.zh: 他们给卧室墙壁贴了墙纸。

entries.notes: 英式名词 practice，动词 practise；美式两者均 practice。practice doing 练习做；in practice 实际上；put into practice 付诸实践。

senses.definitionEn: Repeated activity done to improve a skill.

example.en: Speaking English takes regular practice.
example.zh: 说英语需要经常练习。

senses.definitionEn: To do something repeatedly to improve.

example.en: She practices playing the piano every day.
example.zh: 她每天练习弹钢琴。

senses.definitionEn: The actual use of an idea or method.

example.en: The theory sounds good, but does it work in practice?
example.zh: 这个理论听起来不错，但实际可行吗？

senses.definitionEn: An established or usual way of doing something.

example.en: It is common practice to check references.
example.zh: 核实推荐材料是一种常见做法。

senses.meaningZh: 专业业务；诊所或事务所
senses.definitionEn: The work or business of a doctor, lawyer, or similar professional.

example.en: He opened a dental practice.
example.zh: 他开了一家牙科诊所。

senses.definitionEn: To work in a profession or follow a belief or custom.

example.en: She practices law in London.
example.zh: 她在伦敦从事律师工作。

entries.notes: port 港口，harbour 常指避风水域；USB port 接口；port side 左舷，starboard 右舷。港口与葡萄酒两个义项通常靠语境区分。

senses.definitionEn: A place where ships load, unload, or shelter.

example.en: The ship arrived at the port at dawn.
example.zh: 船于黎明抵达港口。

senses.definitionEn: A connection point on a device or in a network.

example.en: Plug the cable into the USB port.
example.zh: 把电缆插入USB接口。

senses.definitionEn: The left side of a ship when facing forward.

example.en: The island was visible on the port side.
example.zh: 从左舷可以看到那座岛。

senses.definitionEn: A strong sweet fortified wine associated with Portugal.

example.en: He ordered a glass of port.
example.zh: 他点了一杯波特酒。

senses.definitionEn: To adapt software to run on another platform.

example.en: The game was ported to mobile devices.
example.zh: 这款游戏被移植到了移动设备上。

entries.notes: junior to 比……资历低（不用 than）；a junior employee 初级员工；美式大学 junior 通常为三年级学生。姓名后的 Junior/Jr. 表示同名的晚辈。

senses.definitionEn: Younger in age or intended for young people.

example.en: He joined the junior team.
example.zh: 他加入了少年队。

senses.meaningZh: 职位较低的；资历较浅的
senses.definitionEn: Lower in rank or with less experience.

example.en: She is a junior accountant.
example.zh: 她是一名初级会计师。

senses.meaningZh: 较年轻或资历较浅的人
senses.definitionEn: A person younger or lower in rank than another.

example.en: He is three years my junior.
example.zh: 他比我小三岁。

senses.meaningZh: 高中或大学三年级学生
senses.definitionEn: A student in the third year of a four-year high school or college programme.

example.en: She is a junior at college.
example.zh: 她是大学三年级学生。

entries.notes: consider doing 考虑做；consider sb/sth (to be) 认为……是；consider + 疑问词/从句。一般不说 consider to do 表示“考虑做”。

senses.definitionEn: To think carefully about something before deciding.

example.en: We are considering moving to another city.
example.zh: 我们正考虑搬到另一座城市。

senses.definitionEn: To have a particular opinion about someone or something.

example.en: I consider her a reliable friend.
example.zh: 我认为她是一个可靠的朋友。

senses.definitionEn: To take someone's needs or a fact into account.

example.en: Please consider how others might feel.
example.zh: 请顾及别人可能的感受。

senses.definitionEn: To examine a subject formally or in detail.

example.en: The committee will consider the proposal tomorrow.
example.zh: 委员会明天将审议该提案。

entries.notes: used 作“二手的”读 /juːzd/；used to（过去常常）通常 /ˈjuːst tə/；be/get used to 后接名词或 doing；be used to do 表“被用来做”，结构不同。

senses.definitionEn: Previously owned or used by someone.

example.en: He bought a used car.
example.zh: 他买了一辆二手车。

senses.definitionEn: The past tense and past participle of use.

example.en: This tool is used to cut metal.
example.zh: 这个工具被用来切割金属。

senses.meaningZh: 过去常常（现在通常不再如此）
senses.definitionEn: Used with to and a verb for past habits or states.

example.en: I used to walk to school.
example.zh: 我过去常步行上学。

senses.definitionEn: Familiar with something through experience.

example.en: I am used to getting up early.
example.zh: 我习惯早起。

senses.meaningZh: 被利用的；被当作工具的
senses.definitionEn: Made to feel exploited by someone.

example.en: After the deal, she felt used.
example.zh: 交易之后，她觉得自己被利用了。

entries.notes: zoom in/out 放大/缩小视图；zoom in on 聚焦或详细查看；Zoom 大写也可为软件品牌。zoom lens 变焦镜头。

senses.definitionEn: To move very quickly.

example.en: A motorbike zoomed past us.
example.zh: 一辆摩托车从我们身边疾驰而过。

senses.definitionEn: To rise or increase rapidly.

example.en: Sales zoomed after the launch.
example.zh: 产品推出后销量猛增。

senses.definitionEn: To change the apparent size of an image by adjusting the view.

example.en: Zoom in to read the small print.
example.zh: 放大画面来阅读小字。

senses.definitionEn: A change in image magnification or a rapid movement.

example.en: The camera has a powerful optical zoom.
example.zh: 这台相机具有强大的光学变焦功能。

entries.notes: cream 奶油与 ice cream 冰淇淋区分；the cream of 精华；cream off 撇取上层、抽走最有价值部分；creamy 细腻柔滑的。

senses.definitionEn: The rich fatty part of milk.

example.en: Would you like cream in your coffee?
example.zh: 你的咖啡要加奶油吗？

senses.definitionEn: A thick smooth substance used on the skin or in food.

example.en: Apply the cream to your hands.
example.zh: 把乳霜涂在手上。

senses.definitionEn: A pale yellowish-white colour.

example.en: The room has cream walls.
example.zh: 房间的墙是奶油色的。

senses.definitionEn: The best people or things in a group.

example.en: The programme attracts the cream of young researchers.
example.zh: 这个项目吸引了青年研究者中的佼佼者。

senses.meaningZh: 把黄油、糖等搅成乳脂状
senses.definitionEn: To beat ingredients into a smooth creamy mixture.

example.en: Cream the butter and sugar together.
example.zh: 把黄油和糖一起搅打至细腻。

senses.definitionEn: To defeat someone very easily.

example.en: Their team got creamed in the final.
example.zh: 他们队在决赛中惨败。

entries.notes: figure out 弄懂、算出；figure in 在……中起作用；public figure 公众人物；in round figures 用约数。figure 作“认为”较口语。

senses.definitionEn: A number or numerical amount.

example.en: The final figure was higher than expected.
example.zh: 最终数值比预期更高。

senses.definitionEn: A person, especially someone notable.

example.en: She is a leading figure in education.
example.zh: 她是教育界的重要人物。

senses.definitionEn: The shape of a person's body or a visible outline.

example.en: A dark figure stood at the gate.
example.zh: 一个黑色身影站在门口。

senses.definitionEn: A diagram, illustration, or shape.

example.en: Figure three shows the results.
example.zh: 图三展示了结果。

senses.definitionEn: A representation of a person or animal.

example.en: A bronze figure stood in the square.
example.zh: 广场上矗立着一尊铜像。

senses.definitionEn: To think, estimate, or calculate.

example.en: I figured that he would arrive late.
example.zh: 我估计他会迟到。

senses.definitionEn: To appear or have a role in something.

example.en: Cost figures heavily in our decision.
example.zh: 费用在我们的决定中占很大分量。

entries.notes: be full of 充满；in full 全部地；to the full 充分地；full-time 全职的；full stop 英式“句号”。full 作饱的可用于人。

senses.definitionEn: Containing as much as possible.

example.en: The bus is full.
example.zh: 公交车满员了。

senses.definitionEn: Having eaten enough food.

example.en: I am full, thank you.
example.zh: 我吃饱了，谢谢。

senses.definitionEn: Complete, with nothing missing.

example.en: Please give your full name.
example.zh: 请填写你的全名。

senses.definitionEn: At the greatest possible strength or extent.

example.en: The engine was running at full power.
example.zh: 发动机在全功率运行。

senses.definitionEn: Large or rounded in shape, loose in cut, or rich in sound or flavour.

example.en: The singer has a full, warm voice.
example.zh: 这位歌手的声音饱满温暖。

senses.definitionEn: Directly or completely, often in fixed expressions.

example.en: The light shone full in my face.
example.zh: 光直接照在我脸上。

entries.notes: 序数词第二、时间单位秒及动词支持都读 /ˈsekənd/；second 表“借调”通常重音在后，英 /sɪˈkɒnd/、美 /sɪˈkɑːnd/。second-hand 二手的、间接的。

senses.definitionEn: Coming immediately after the first.

example.en: She finished second in the race.
example.zh: 她在比赛中获得第二名。

senses.definitionEn: A unit of time equal to one sixtieth of a minute, or a short moment.

example.en: Wait a second, please.
example.zh: 请稍等片刻。

senses.definitionEn: Another of the same kind or an additional one.

example.en: Could I have a second cup?
example.zh: 我可以再来一杯吗？

senses.definitionEn: To formally support a proposal made by someone else.

example.en: I second the motion.
example.zh: 我附议这项动议。

senses.definitionEn: To transfer an employee temporarily to another position.

example.en: She was seconded to the research team.
example.zh: 她被借调到研究团队。

senses.definitionEn: An additional helping of food, or goods of imperfect quality.

example.en: Anyone who wants seconds can help themselves.
example.zh: 想再添一份的人可以自取。

entries.notes: a sign of ……的迹象；sign up (for) 报名；sign in/out 签到/签退；sign for 签收。signal 常强调传递信号，sign 还可指自然迹象。

senses.definitionEn: Something showing that a condition exists or may develop.

example.en: There was no sign of rain.
example.zh: 没有要下雨的迹象。

senses.definitionEn: A notice or symbol giving information.

example.en: Follow the signs to the exit.
example.zh: 沿着指示牌走向出口。

senses.definitionEn: A written mark or movement conveying meaning.

example.en: A plus sign means addition.
example.zh: 加号表示加法。

senses.definitionEn: One of the twelve divisions of the zodiac.

example.en: What is your star sign?
example.zh: 你是什么星座？

senses.definitionEn: To write a name on a document or enter an agreement.

example.en: Please sign at the bottom of the form.
example.zh: 请在表格底部签名。

senses.definitionEn: To communicate with gestures or sign language.

example.en: She signed that we should wait.
example.zh: 她打手势示意我们等待。

entries.notes: keep/lose one's balance 保持/失去平衡；on balance 总的来说；bank balance 银行余额；balance A against B 权衡；work-life balance 工作与生活平衡。

senses.definitionEn: A steady state without falling; to remain or keep steady.

example.en: He lost his balance and fell.
example.zh: 他失去平衡摔倒了。

senses.definitionEn: A fair or suitable relationship between competing things.

example.en: She balances study with a part-time job.
example.zh: 她兼顾学习与兼职工作。

senses.definitionEn: Money in an account or an amount still owed.

example.en: Please pay the remaining balance by Friday.
example.zh: 请在周五前付清余款。

senses.definitionEn: To make totals match or keep spending within income.

example.en: We need to balance the budget.
example.zh: 我们需要平衡预算。

senses.definitionEn: An instrument used to compare or measure weight.

example.en: The sample was weighed on a laboratory balance.
example.zh: 样品用实验室天平称重。

entries.notes: under stress 处于压力下；stress the importance of 强调……的重要性；stress on 某音节的重音；stressful 令人有压力的，stressed 感到压力的。

senses.definitionEn: Mental pressure, or to feel or cause worry.

example.en: Exams can cause a lot of stress.
example.zh: 考试可能带来很大压力。

senses.definitionEn: Special importance given to something; to emphasize it.

example.en: The teacher stressed the need for practice.
example.zh: 老师强调了练习的必要性。

senses.definitionEn: Extra force given to a syllable or word.

example.en: The stress falls on the first syllable.
example.zh: 重音落在第一个音节上。

senses.definitionEn: Force within a material caused by an external load; to subject it to force.

example.en: The bridge must withstand heavy stress.
example.zh: 这座桥必须承受很大的应力。

entries.notes: due to + 名词/doing 表原因；be due to do 预计或按安排将做；be due for 应当得到、该进行。be due to illness 是“因病”，be due to arrive 是“预计到达”。

senses.definitionEn: Required to be paid or submitted by a particular time.

example.en: The assignment is due on Friday.
example.zh: 作业周五截止。

senses.definitionEn: Expected or scheduled at a particular time.

example.en: The train is due to arrive at six.
example.zh: 火车预计六点到达。

senses.definitionEn: Deserved or appropriate in the circumstances.

example.en: Give her the respect that is due to her.
example.zh: 给予她应得的尊重。

senses.definitionEn: Caused by something, used with to.

example.en: The delay was due to heavy traffic.
example.zh: 延误是交通拥堵造成的。

senses.definitionEn: Something deserved, or regular membership payments.

example.en: Members must pay their annual dues.
example.zh: 会员必须缴纳年费。

senses.definitionEn: Exactly in a compass direction.

example.en: The village lies due north of here.
example.zh: 村庄在这里的正北方。

entries.notes: wave at/to 向……挥手；wave goodbye 挥手告别；a wave of 一波……；wave aside 对……置之不理。wave 与 waive（放弃权利）不同。

senses.definitionEn: A moving ridge of water or a disturbance carrying energy.

example.en: Large waves hit the shore.
example.zh: 巨浪拍打着海岸。

senses.definitionEn: To move a hand or object back and forth.

example.en: She waved goodbye from the window.
example.zh: 她从窗口挥手告别。

senses.definitionEn: To move in a flowing up-and-down motion.

example.en: Flags waved in the wind.
example.zh: 旗帜在风中飘扬。

senses.definitionEn: A sudden increase or movement affecting many people.

example.en: A wave of excitement spread through the crowd.
example.zh: 一阵兴奋传遍了人群。

senses.definitionEn: A curve in hair, or to make hair form curves.

example.en: Her hair falls in soft waves.
example.zh: 她的头发呈柔和的波浪状垂落。

entries.notes: rank first 排第一；rank A above B 把A排在B之前；the rank and file 普通成员；a taxi rank 英式出租车候客点。

senses.definitionEn: A position in a hierarchy or system.

example.en: She rose to the rank of captain.
example.zh: 她升到了上尉军衔。

senses.definitionEn: To place or be placed in an order of quality or importance.

example.en: The university ranks among the best.
example.zh: 这所大学跻身最优秀的大学之列。

senses.definitionEn: A row of people or things.

example.en: The soldiers stood in ranks.
example.zh: 士兵们列队站立。

senses.definitionEn: The members of a group or organization.

example.en: He joined the ranks of professional writers.
example.zh: 他加入了职业作家的行列。

senses.definitionEn: Having a strong unpleasant smell, or growing too thickly.

example.en: A rank smell came from the drain.
example.zh: 排水沟里传来一股恶臭。

senses.definitionEn: Complete or extreme, usually in a bad sense.

example.en: That is rank hypocrisy.
example.zh: 那是十足的虚伪。

entries.notes: runner-up 亚军，复数 runners-up；front-runner 领先者；a long-distance runner 长跑运动员；runner 还可用于植物、家具和地毯。

senses.definitionEn: Someone who runs, especially as a sport.

example.en: She is a long-distance runner.
example.zh: 她是一名长跑运动员。

senses.definitionEn: A person or animal taking part in a race or contest.

example.en: There are six runners in the final.
example.zh: 决赛有六名选手。

senses.meaningZh: 跑腿人员；传递消息或物品的人
senses.definitionEn: Someone employed to carry messages or do small tasks.

example.en: He worked as a runner on a film set.
example.zh: 他在电影片场做跑腿工作。

senses.definitionEn: A long narrow carpet or strip of decorative cloth.

example.en: A runner covered the hallway floor.
example.zh: 走廊地面铺着一条长地毯。

senses.definitionEn: A horizontal plant stem that roots to form new plants.

example.en: Strawberry plants produce runners.
example.zh: 草莓植株会长出匍匐茎。

senses.definitionEn: A support or track along which something slides.

example.en: The drawer slides smoothly on its runners.
example.zh: 抽屉沿着滑轨顺畅滑动。

entries.notes: an email attachment 邮件附件；attachment to 对……的依恋；attachment theory 依恋理论。attach A to B 把A附在B上。

senses.definitionEn: A file sent together with an electronic message.

example.en: Please open the attachment.
example.zh: 请打开附件。

senses.definitionEn: An extra part fitted to a tool or machine.

example.en: The vacuum cleaner has a brush attachment.
example.zh: 吸尘器配有一个刷头附件。

senses.definitionEn: A strong emotional bond with someone or something.

example.en: She has a deep attachment to her hometown.
example.zh: 她对家乡有深厚的感情。

senses.definitionEn: The act of fastening something or the place where it joins.

example.en: Check the attachment of the cable to the wall.
example.zh: 检查电缆与墙壁的固定连接。

senses.definitionEn: A temporary assignment to another department or organization.

example.en: He is on attachment to another department.
example.zh: 他正被临时派驻到另一个部门。

senses.definitionEn: A legal process of seizing property to secure or satisfy a claim.

example.en: The court ordered the attachment of the debtor's property.
example.zh: 法院下令扣押债务人的财产。

entries.notes: spring—sprang—sprung；spring up 涌现；spring from 源于；spring into action 突然行动；spring a surprise on sb 让某人大吃一惊。

senses.definitionEn: The season between winter and summer.

example.en: The trees blossom in spring.
example.zh: 树木在春天开花。

senses.definitionEn: A coiled piece of metal that returns to its shape after pressure.

example.en: The mattress has broken springs.
example.zh: 床垫里的弹簧坏了。

senses.definitionEn: A place where water naturally flows from the ground.

example.en: The village gets water from a spring.
example.zh: 村庄从一眼泉中取水。

senses.definitionEn: To jump or move suddenly; a jump or the ability to bounce.

example.en: The cat sprang onto the wall.
example.zh: 猫一下跳到了墙上。

senses.definitionEn: To appear quickly or originate from something.

example.en: New shops sprang up near the station.
example.zh: 车站附近迅速出现了许多新商店。

senses.meaningZh: 突然告知或出其不意地提出
senses.definitionEn: To present something unexpected to someone.

example.en: They sprang a surprise test on us.
example.zh: 他们突然给我们来了一次测验。

entries.notes: 动词 live /lɪv/，形容词/副词 live /laɪv/。live in 居住于；live on 靠……生活；live up to 不辜负；live a happy life 过幸福生活。

senses.definitionEn: To have a home in a place or spend one's life in a way.

example.en: I live in Guangzhou.
example.zh: 我住在广州。

senses.definitionEn: To be alive or remain alive.

example.en: Some trees live for hundreds of years.
example.zh: 有些树能活数百年。

senses.definitionEn: To support oneself or continue to exist in memory or effect.

example.en: Her memory lives on.
example.zh: 人们一直怀念着她。

senses.definitionEn: Alive rather than dead.

example.en: The market sells live fish.
example.zh: 市场出售活鱼。

senses.meaningZh: 现场直播的；现场演出的；实时地
senses.definitionEn: Broadcast, performed, or transmitted as it happens.

example.en: The concert will be broadcast live.
example.zh: 音乐会将进行现场直播。

senses.definitionEn: Carrying an electric current.

example.en: Do not touch the live wire.
example.zh: 不要碰那根带电的电线。

senses.definitionEn: Containing an explosive charge that can still be fired or detonated.

example.en: The soldiers trained with live ammunition.
example.zh: 士兵使用实弹进行训练。

senses.meaningZh: 当前有效的；仍待处理的
senses.definitionEn: Currently operating, available, or under active consideration.

example.en: This is still a live issue for the committee.
example.zh: 这仍是委员会正在处理的问题。

entries.notes: a knife and fork 刀叉；a fork in the road 岔路口；fork out 非正式“大笔掏钱”；代码 fork 指从现有项目分出独立开发副本。

senses.definitionEn: A tool with two or more pointed prongs.

example.en: Use a fork to eat the pasta.
example.zh: 用叉子吃意大利面。

senses.definitionEn: A place where a road, river, or branch divides.

example.en: Take the left road at the fork.
example.zh: 在岔路口走左边的路。

senses.definitionEn: To divide into branches or separate routes.

example.en: The path forks near the lake.
example.zh: 小路在湖边分岔。

senses.definitionEn: A separate version made from existing code; to create such a version.

example.en: They forked the project to add new features.
example.zh: 他们从项目分出副本，以开发新功能。

entries.notes: a buck 非正式“一美元”；pass the buck 推卸责任；buck the trend 逆势而行；buck up 振作起来。雄鹿常见，雌鹿常称 doe。

senses.definitionEn: A male deer, rabbit, or certain other animals.

example.en: A buck stood at the edge of the forest.
example.zh: 一只雄鹿站在森林边缘。

senses.meaningZh: 美元；某些国家的一元钱
senses.definitionEn: A dollar, especially in informal speech.

example.en: The ticket cost ten bucks.
example.zh: 票价是十美元。

senses.definitionEn: For an animal to jump with its back arched and hind legs kicking.

example.en: The horse bucked and threw the rider.
example.zh: 马尥起蹶子，把骑手摔了下来。

senses.definitionEn: To resist authority or go against a trend.

example.en: The shop bucked the trend and increased sales.
example.zh: 这家店逆势而上，销量增加了。

senses.definitionEn: Responsibility, especially in expressions about avoiding it.

example.en: Stop passing the buck and make a decision.
example.zh: 别再推卸责任了，做个决定吧。

entries.notes: image of ……的图像或印象；public image 公众形象；mental image 脑海中的画面；be the image of 与……十分相像。image 不等同于 imagination 想象力。

senses.definitionEn: A visual representation, photograph, or reflected likeness.

example.en: The mirror produced a clear image.
example.zh: 镜子映出了清晰的影像。

senses.definitionEn: A picture formed in the mind.

example.en: The story created a vivid image in my mind.
example.zh: 这个故事在我脑海中形成了生动的画面。

senses.definitionEn: The general impression others have of a person or organization.

example.en: The company wants to improve its image.
example.zh: 公司希望改善自身形象。

senses.definitionEn: A word or description that creates a vivid comparison or picture.

example.en: The poem uses images of light and darkness.
example.zh: 这首诗运用了光明与黑暗的意象。

senses.definitionEn: To produce a picture or digital copy of something.

example.en: The scanner images the inside of the body.
example.zh: 扫描仪对人体内部进行成像。

entries.notes: universal access 人人可及；universal agreement 普遍共识；universal truth 普遍真理；universal charger 通用充电器。“普遍”有时是概括，并非精确统计的所有。

senses.definitionEn: Existing everywhere or shared by everyone in a group.

example.en: The desire for safety is universal.
example.zh: 对安全的渴望是普遍的。

senses.definitionEn: Relating to the whole world or all people.

example.en: The declaration sets out universal human rights.
example.zh: 该宣言阐明了普遍人权。

senses.definitionEn: Suitable for many different uses or systems.

example.en: This is a universal remote control.
example.zh: 这是一个通用遥控器。

senses.definitionEn: A general property or concept shared by particular things.

example.en: The course examines the problem of universals.
example.zh: 这门课探讨共相问题。

entries.notes: strain 与 stress 有重叠；材料力学中 stress 是应力，strain 是应变。strain a muscle 拉伤肌肉；put a strain on 给……造成负担。

senses.definitionEn: Pressure that stretches someone's resources or endurance.

example.en: The extra work put a strain on her.
example.zh: 额外工作给她造成了负担。

senses.definitionEn: To injure a muscle by stretching it too much; such an injury.

example.en: He strained a muscle in his back.
example.zh: 他拉伤了背部肌肉。

senses.definitionEn: To make a great effort or stretch something tightly.

example.en: I strained to hear the announcement.
example.zh: 我竭力听清广播。

senses.definitionEn: To separate liquid from solids using a filter.

example.en: Strain the soup before serving.
example.zh: 上桌前把汤过滤一下。

senses.definitionEn: A variety of an organism or a particular type.

example.en: Researchers identified a new strain of the virus.
example.zh: 研究人员识别出一种新的病毒株。

senses.definitionEn: The sound of a tune or passage of music.

example.en: We heard the strains of a violin.
example.zh: 我们听到了小提琴的旋律。

senses.definitionEn: Deformation measured relative to original size.

example.en: The gauge measures strain in the metal.
example.zh: 仪器测量金属中的应变。

entries.notes: bound 有多个来源：bind—bound—bound（捆绑）；bound 作跳跃用规则变化 bounded；be bound to do 必定/很可能；be bound for 前往；be bound by 受约束。

senses.definitionEn: Certain or very likely to do something, used with to.

example.en: You are bound to make mistakes at first.
example.zh: 你刚开始很可能会犯错。

senses.definitionEn: Required by duty, law, or an agreement.

example.en: We are bound by the contract.
example.zh: 我们受合同约束。

senses.definitionEn: Travelling toward a particular destination.

example.en: This train is bound for Beijing.
example.zh: 这列火车开往北京。

senses.definitionEn: Tied, fastened, or joined, as a form of bind.

example.en: The books were bound in leather.
example.zh: 这些书用皮革装订。

senses.definitionEn: To move with large jumps; a long jump.

example.en: The dog bounded across the field.
example.zh: 狗蹦跳着穿过田野。

senses.definitionEn: A limit or boundary.

example.en: His enthusiasm knows no bounds.
example.zh: 他的热情无穷无尽。

senses.definitionEn: To form a boundary around something.

example.en: The garden is bounded by a low wall.
example.zh: 花园以一道矮墙为界。

entries.notes: a rock band 摇滚乐队；a band of 一群；a rubber band 橡皮筋；band together 联合起来；bandwidth 带宽。

senses.definitionEn: A group of musicians who perform together.

example.en: She plays guitar in a band.
example.zh: 她在一个乐队里弹吉他。

senses.definitionEn: A group of people sharing an activity or purpose.

example.en: A band of volunteers cleaned the beach.
example.zh: 一群志愿者清理了海滩。

senses.definitionEn: A strip or loop of material.

example.en: She tied the papers with a rubber band.
example.zh: 她用橡皮筋捆住文件。

senses.definitionEn: A stripe of colour or contrasting material.

example.en: The snake has yellow bands.
example.zh: 这条蛇身上有黄色条纹。

senses.definitionEn: A range of values, frequencies, or categories.

example.en: The job falls within a higher pay band.
example.zh: 这份工作属于较高的薪酬等级。

senses.definitionEn: To fasten with a band or join together as a group.

example.en: Local families banded together to help.
example.zh: 当地家庭联合起来提供帮助。

entries.notes: in line 排队；on the line 在线上、面临风险；in line with 与……一致；line up 排队；draw the line 划清界限；bottom line 底线或最终结果。

senses.definitionEn: A long narrow mark, edge, or wrinkle.

example.en: Draw a straight line.
example.zh: 画一条直线。

senses.definitionEn: A row of written words or a sentence spoken in a play.

example.en: The actor forgot his lines.
example.zh: 那位演员忘词了。

senses.definitionEn: A row of people or things, especially a queue.

example.en: We waited in line for tickets.
example.zh: 我们排队等着买票。

senses.definitionEn: A route or connection for transport or communication.

example.en: The phone line is busy.
example.zh: 电话占线。

senses.definitionEn: A dividing boundary or a position taken on an issue.

example.en: The river marks the line between the two regions.
example.zh: 这条河是两个地区的分界线。

senses.definitionEn: A field of work or range of related products.

example.en: The company launched a new line of shoes.
example.zh: 公司推出了一个新的鞋类系列。

senses.definitionEn: A length of cord, or a chain of descent.

example.en: His family line goes back centuries.
example.zh: 他的家族血统可追溯数百年。

senses.definitionEn: To form a row along the edge or sides of something.

example.en: Trees line both sides of the road.
example.zh: 道路两旁树木成行。

senses.definitionEn: To cover the inside of something with a layer of material.

example.en: Line the tin with baking paper.
example.zh: 在烤模内铺上烘焙纸。

entries.notes: lean—leaned/leant；lean against 靠着；lean toward(s) 倾向于；lean on 倚靠、依赖，也可指施压。lean meat 瘦肉；lean management 精益管理。

senses.definitionEn: To bend from an upright position or rest against something.

example.en: He leaned against the wall.
example.zh: 他倚靠着墙。

senses.definitionEn: To be inclined toward an opinion or choice.

example.en: I lean towards the cheaper option.
example.zh: 我倾向于较便宜的方案。

senses.definitionEn: To depend on someone or pressure them, used with on.

example.en: You can lean on your friends for support.
example.zh: 你可以依靠朋友获得支持。

senses.definitionEn: Thin and fit, or containing little fat.

example.en: Choose lean meat for this dish.
example.zh: 做这道菜要选瘦肉。

senses.definitionEn: Using only necessary resources and avoiding waste.

example.en: They run a lean organization.
example.zh: 他们管理着一个精简高效的组织。

senses.definitionEn: Having little money, food, or other resources.

example.en: The family faced several lean years.
example.zh: 这家人度过了几年拮据的日子。

senses.definitionEn: An inclination in position or preference.

example.en: The tower has a noticeable lean.
example.zh: 这座塔明显倾斜。

entries.notes: post a letter 寄信（英式）；a job post 职位；post a message 发消息；keep sb posted 让某人随时了解情况；post-war 战后的（post- 前缀“之后”）。

senses.definitionEn: The system of sending letters or the letters delivered.

example.en: The parcel arrived in the morning post.
example.zh: 包裹随早上的邮件送到了。

senses.definitionEn: To send by mail or publish information publicly.

example.en: She posted a message online.
example.zh: 她在网上发布了一条消息。

senses.definitionEn: An item published on a website or social platform.

example.en: I read your latest post.
example.zh: 我看了你最新的帖子。

senses.definitionEn: A job or a place where someone is assigned to work.

example.en: He accepted a teaching post.
example.zh: 他接受了一个教师职位。

senses.definitionEn: An upright piece of wood or metal.

example.en: The ball hit the goalpost.
example.zh: 球击中了球门柱。

senses.definitionEn: To assign someone to a place or display a notice.

example.en: A guard was posted at the entrance.
example.zh: 入口处安排了一名警卫。

senses.definitionEn: To report financial results or enter a transaction in an account.

example.en: The company posted a profit this year.
example.zh: 公司公布今年实现盈利。

entries.notes: a quarter of 四分之一；a quarter past six 六点一刻；a quarter to six 差一刻六点；quarters 表住所，headquarters 总部。

senses.definitionEn: One of four equal parts, or fifteen minutes.

example.en: A quarter of the class was absent.
example.zh: 班里四分之一的学生缺席。

senses.definitionEn: A three-month business period or one of four parts of a game.

example.en: Sales rose in the first quarter.
example.zh: 第一季度销售额增长了。

senses.definitionEn: A coin worth twenty-five cents.

example.en: The machine takes quarters.
example.zh: 这台机器接收二十五美分硬币。

senses.meaningZh: 城区；区域；某一方面的人士
senses.definitionEn: A district of a town, or a source of opinion or support.

example.en: We walked through the old quarter.
example.zh: 我们步行穿过老城区。

senses.definitionEn: Rooms or buildings used as accommodation.

example.en: The staff quarters are behind the hotel.
example.zh: 员工宿舍在酒店后面。

senses.meaningZh: 把……分成四份；为……安排住宿
senses.definitionEn: To divide into four parts or provide accommodation.

example.en: Quarter the apples before cooking.
example.zh: 烹煮前把苹果切成四块。

senses.definitionEn: Mercy shown to a defeated opponent.

example.en: The commander ordered his men to give no quarter.
example.zh: 指挥官命令士兵不要饶恕敌人。
